csv_scope_of_work: This Request for Qualifications (RFQ) is to obtain Professional Architectural/Engineering (A/E) services for the planning, design and construction oversight of Multi-Building and Multi-Renovation projects at Central State University. This project will repair and renovate buildings at Central State University, Wilberforce, Ohio. Buildings under consideration for the project will be prioritized and sequenced to minimize impacts to buildings and occupants. The project s construction will likely be completed in phases and may bridge multi-biennia. The university reserves the right to add, modify or delete scope or buildings as noted in the RFQ. The following scopes of work will be required, but not limited to, for this project, Building Envelope, HVAC, Plumbing, Electrical, Architectural, Structural, and minimal FF&E.
